questions.prompt: What helped Anna ride without wobbling?
choices: She kept her eyes where she wanted to go.
She kept her eyes on the ground by the wheel.
She kept her eyes closed as she pedalled.
questions.answer: She kept her eyes where she wanted to go.
questions.evidenceText: "How did you DO that?" said James. "I kept my eyes on where I wanted to go," said Anna. "Don't look at the ground."

questions.prompt: What happened when James rode with no hands?
choices: He headed straight into the bush.
questions.answer: He headed straight into the bush.
questions.evidenceText: Then James tried riding with NO hands. He made it exactly three seconds before heading straight into the same bush.

questions.prompt: How did their race home finish?
questions.evidenceText: On the way home, James and Anna raced. They crossed the gate post at exactly the same time. A perfect tie.
